abilities.name: Lightning Blade
_curatorNotes: Skill: 1-3 sword-blade hits at skillHitmark=21f. Mult per hit: skill[lvl=10]=141.6% ATK Electro. 1 Electro particle per blade-hit (no ICD per hit; 1 per attack instance).
Cooldown: SetCDWithDelay(skill, 810f=13.5s, 20).

Abundance Amulets: spawns up to 2 amulets (3 with C1). Picked up by the active char ~1.79s after cast (amuletDelay=107f). Each amulet on pickup grants: +20% ER for 6s + flat Energy = skillRegen[lvl=10]=4 per amulet. Effect authored as a single energy effect (4 Energy to active, onCast skill — represents a single-amulet mid-rotation pickup); the 2-amulet/3-amulet base case is undercount-by-design since the planner can't model variable amulet count + ER buff routing.
A1 (Resounding Roar): when an off-field teammate picks up an amulet, Lightning Blade CD reduced by 1.5s per amulet. Conditional cooldown reduction not authored.
A4: amulet ER buff scaled by 10% of Traveler's base ER. Composite buff scaling not authored.
Frames: skillFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(57), ActionBurst=56 ActionDash=42 ActionJump=42 ActionSwap=56. Per E-spec swap/N/Q/D/J.
abilities.description: Brandishing the discarded sword, the Traveler hurls it forward with a flash of lightning, dealing Electro DMG to opponents in its path. The sword will then split into 3 Abundance Amulets, granting Energy to the character that touches it.

abilities.name: Bellowing Thunder
_curatorNotes: Initial burst hit at burstHitmark=37: 205.92% ATK Electro. After cast, opens a 12s 'Lightning Shroud' window during which active-char N/CA hits proc Falling Thunder (59.04% ATK Electro at lvl=10, 0.5s ICD) on the hit enemy. Each Falling Thunder also grants the active char burstRegen[lvl=10]=1 Energy.

Authored as `behavior: persistent + duration: 12 + persistentBehavior: follows` (the buff window follows the active char). Falling Thunder authored as TWO damage effects with onHit triggers (abilityType normal + charged) and procCooldown:0.5 — the 0.5s ICD is shared between the two in gcsim but the schema doesn't have an onHit:any-physical-tag option.
Energy regen on Falling Thunder hit: not authored as a separate effect — would need a per-proc energy-callback. Documented; flagged.
Burst frames: burstFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(63), ActionAttack=62 ActionDash=62 ActionJump=61 ActionSwap=60. Per Q-spec swap/N/E/D/J — E defaults to animLen=63.
Cooldown: SetCDWithDelay(burst, 1200f=20s, 35). EnergyMax=80. ConsumeEnergy(37) drains 37 energy from teammates.

C2 (Violet Vehemence) resShred authored (capability sweep 2026-07-28): -15% Electro RES for 8s on Falling-Thunder-hit enemies — gcsim internal/characters/traveler/common/electro/cons.go:12-27 (AddResistMod Ele: Electro, Value: -0.15, 480f = 8s), attached to Falling Thunder hits at burst.go:133. Hosted here alongside the Falling Thunder damage effects so it inherits the burst-active window; the onHit abilityType array (normal+charged) shares ONE 0.5s ICD clock, matching gcsim's shared Falling Thunder ICD.
C6 (World-Shaker): every 2 Falling Thunders, the next is x2 DMG + restores +1 Energy. Stack-counted-on-trigger primitive missing; not authored.

A6 rigor 2026-07-12: Falling Thunder scaling corrected 32.8 -> 59.04 (talent lvl 10; gcsim stats.go burstTick[9]=0.5904 — prior 32.8 was the lvl-1 figure burstTick[0], and no talent sidecar exists so the 2026-07-12 normalization sweep skipped this char). Also fixed stale note constants: Falling Thunder 32.8%->59.04%, and burstRegen[lvl=10] 4->1 (gcsim burstRegen[9]=1; the 4 confused it with skillRegen).
abilities.description: Releases the powers of lightning, dealing Electro DMG to surrounding opponents and creating a Lightning Shroud field around the Traveler. The Traveler's Normal and Charged Attacks while within this field will trigger Falling Thunder, which will damage enemies.

passives.name: Thunderflash
_curatorNotes: A per-pickup CD reduction fired by a TEAMMATE's amulet pickup. Amulets are not modelled (the skill's single energy effect stands in for one pickup), so there is no event to hang it on. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15 from genshin-db: the hand-written file carried this text under the A4's name and the A4's text under this one.
passives.description: When another nearby character in the party obtains an Abundance Amulet created by Lightning Blade, Lightning Blade's CD is decreased by 1.5s.

passives.name: Resounding Roar
_curatorNotes: The amulet's ER buff is itself unmodelled (see the skill's notes), so its +10%-of-the-Traveler's-ER rider has nothing to attach to. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: names were swapped with the A1's.
passives.description: Increases the Energy Recharge effect granted by Lightning Blade's Abundance Amulet by 10% of the Traveler's Energy Recharge.

constellations.name: Spring Thunder of Fertility
_curatorNotes: Amulet cap 2 → 3. Amulet pickup is unmodelled (the skill's energy effect is one pickup), so nothing to author. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: the retired entry was named 'Prodigious Thunder'.
constellations.description: The number of Abundance Amulets that can be generated using Lightning Blade is increased to 3.

constellations.name: Violet Vehemence
_curatorNotes: Authored on the burst's effects[] (traveler_electro__burst__bellowing_thunder) with a constellation:2 condition, beside the Falling Thunder damage effects it rides — capability sweep 2026-07-28; gcsim cons.go `c2` (−15% Electro RES, 480f).
constellations.description: When Falling Thunder created by Bellowing Thunder hits an opponent, it will decrease their Electro RES by 15% for 8s.

constellations.name: Fickle Cloudstrike
_curatorNotes: Doubles an amulet's Energy when the collector is below 35% Energy — amulet pickup and an Energy-percentage condition are both unmodelled. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: the retired entry was named 'Excessive Voltage'.
constellations.description: When a character obtains Abundance Amulets generated by Lightning Blade, if this character's Energy is less than 35%, the Energy restored by the Abundance Amulets is increased by 100%.

constellations.description:

Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: World-Shaker
_curatorNotes: Every third Falling Thunder deals 200% and grants +1 Energy (gcsim `c6Damage`, a counter on the burst's hits). A count-triggered damage multiplier has no primitive and no pixel; description-only.
constellations.description: Every 2 Falling Thunder attacks triggered by Bellowing Thunder will greatly increase the DMG dealt by the next Falling Thunder, which will deal 200% of its original DMG and will restore an additional 1 Energy to the current character.
